openings.claim: Speculatively, immutable row occurrences linked by explicit supersession, status meanings and cutoff eligibility could identify a retroactive correction already represented under a different row ID, avoiding double application while retaining every occurrence. Equal normalized quantities suggest aliases, never establish identity.
openings.discriminator: Against literal superseded-row lookup using the same ledger, unique explicit cross-report links should enable justified reconciliation where identifiers alone leave disagreement. Losing an indispensable supersession edge or encountering an undefined status should withdraw affected definite conclusions. Identical behavior or no distinguishing case leaves capability unconfirmed.
openings.probe: Within sixty minutes, compare both variants on intact and disturbed supplied copies; reserve ten minutes to freeze all twelve batch outputs with citations, each a quantity or bounded disagreement naming competing records and unknowns. Retain duplicates, unmatched occurrences and original units; normalize only U=5V; never impute neighboring quantities. Issue at most three prioritized requests naming missing fields or records; retain residual disagreements. In the separate twenty-minute comparison, open the sealed key; compare resolved-batch counts, unsupported definite claims and request counts, checking disturbance-specific changes in justified conclusions.
openings.uncertainty: Authoritative cross-ID links may be absent; quantity equality and chronology cannot supply them. Defeat: unsupported alias, definite quantity surviving indispensable evidence loss, or contradiction by the sealed key. Constructing and checking both variants within the review budget is unproved.

lineage.reason: Preserves the provenance-graph hypothesis, literal-lookup rival, disturbance sensitivity and explicit-evidence requirement.

decision: Run an enabling probe, not deployment. Freeze bounded disagreements whenever evidence or time is insufficient; more than three independent gaps exceeds follow-up coverage without authorizing invented resolution.
